# spc-famhp (PHAROS fixture)

FAMHP medicines database, saved 7 November 2026, 00:10 Cairo.

* `documents_excerpt.csv`: the header, the first twelve ivabradine rows and one veterinary row of
  `https://medicinesdatabase.be/download/documents` (one row per pack, 50 MB, `;`-separated). Only CTI 515377
  (Ivabradine AB) links a national RCP (`app.fagg-afmps.be/pharma-status/api/files/…`); the others link EMA.
